concerns.text: The specification contains no Success Criteria (SC‑xxx) entries. Every SC must be measurable (e.g., p50 latency ≤ 200 ms, Spearman ρ ≥ 0.4 with p < 0.01). Without explicit SCs the project has no objective way to determine completion.
FR‑001 mentions an “acceptable freshness interval” but never defines the interval (e.g., 30 days). A verifier cannot know whether a device should be excluded, making the requirement untestable.

The Time‑Window robustness check requires performance metrics from a fixed 30‑day historical window. The IBM Quantum backend‑properties API only returns the current calibration snapshot; the spec does not describe how older snapshots will be obtained, so the required input may be unreachable.
